jobs.title: Director of AI
jobs.description:
About Apply

APPLY is the Agentic Customer Experience (ACx) partner for the world's most ambitious consumer and entertainment brands. We bring together deep domain expertise across Retail, CPG, Sports, and Media with AI-native delivery capability, designing and delivering agentic solutions that turn CX vision into commercial reality. We are the partner of choice for brands like Arc'teryx, NFL, Lululemon, and Kraft Heinz. For more information, visit applydigital.com .

LOCATION:
APPLY is hybrid/remote friendly. The preferred candidate should be based in Canada, working in hours that align to ET (Eastern Timezone) or PT (Pacific Timezone).

THE ROLE:

Are you an experienced AI engineering leader who can turn complex business problems into reliable, production-ready AI solutions? Do you enjoy working directly with clients while staying close enough to the technology to shape architectures, guide engineers, and resolve critical delivery challenges?

APPLY is seeking a Director of AI to lead the design and delivery of AI-enabled products and platforms across client engagements. This senior, client-facing role combines AI and software engineering expertise with consulting judgment, product thinking, and technical leadership.

You will help clients move from AI ambition to working solutions—from identifying valuable opportunities and rapidly validating ideas to engineering, deploying, and operating secure, scalable AI applications. You will serve as a senior technical authority while contributing hands-on expertise through architecture, prototyping, technical reviews, and delivery oversight.

You will also help advance APPLY’s AI engineering capability by developing reusable patterns, standards, accelerators, and delivery practices.

Responsibilities

Lead the technical strategy, architecture, and delivery of AI applications from discovery and experimentation through production and scale.
Work with client executives, product leaders, architects, and engineering teams to identify valuable AI opportunities and translate them into achievable technical roadmaps.
Design AI applications that combine models, enterprise data, APIs, software components, user experiences, and human workflows.
Guide the implementation of agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, enterprise search, predictive models, and AI capabilities embedded in digital products.
Determine when to use deterministic software, machine learning, large language models, human review, or a combination of approaches.
Establish evaluation-driven development practices, including test datasets, error analysis, deterministic checks, model-based evaluation, and business outcome measurement.
Ensure solutions meet production requirements for reliability, observability, scalability, latency, maintainability, security, and cost.
Guide practices for CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, monitoring, tracing, regression testing, and ongoing optimization.
Provide hands-on technical leadership through prototyping, architecture reviews, code reviews, troubleshooting, and delivery oversight.
Use AI-assisted development and coding agents effectively while maintaining appropriate verification, security, and human oversight.
Support proposals, discovery workshops, solution design, estimates, and executive presentations.
Develop reusable AI engineering patterns, reference architectures, accelerators, and delivery standards.
Contribute to hiring, technical mentorship, and the continued growth of APPLY’s AI capability.

Requirements

10+ years of experience across software engineering, data engineering, machine learning, or related technology disciplines, including significant experience leading AI or ML solutions.
Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating AI or machine learning applications in production—not only proofs of concept.
Strong software engineering foundation, including system design, APIs, data architecture, testing, security, cloud infrastructure, and production operations.
Hands-on proficiency in Python and experience with modern application, data, and AI engineering frameworks.
Strong understanding of LLMs, RAG, context engineering, agentic workflows, tool use, structured outputs, and model evaluation.
Experience grounding AI systems in enterprise data, including structured data, documents, semantic models, vector stores, or knowledge graphs.
Experience establishing evaluation and error-analysis practices for systems with probabilistic outputs.
Ability to balance model quality, reliability, latency, cost, security, and user experience.
Experience with cloud-native architecture and production deployment on GCP, AWS, or Azure.
Familiarity with containers, CI/CD, observability, and MLOps or LLMOps practices.
Demonstrated success in a consulting, professional-services, or complex client-facing environment.
Ability to move comfortably between executive conversations, product decisions, architecture discussions, and detailed technical problem-solving.
Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
A degree in computer science, software engineering, artificial intelligence, data science, or a related field—or equivalent professional experience.

NICE TO HAVES

Experience delivering AI solutions in regulated, privacy-sensitive, or large-scale enterprise environments.
Experience with model fine-tuning, open-source models, multimodal AI, voice agents, or computer-use agents.
Experience implementing enterprise AI security controls, including prompt-injection defenses, tool permissions, and human approval gates.
Experience building internal AI platforms, reusable agent frameworks, or developer enablement capabilities.
Experience contributing to organizational AI strategy, operating models, or technical standards.
Professional certifications or significant delivery experience with GCP, Snowflake, Databricks, or comparable platforms.

LIFE AT APPLY

People are at the core of everything we do at APPLY. We provide you with modern tools, systems and approaches, value your time, safety, and health, and strive to build a work community where you can thrive and grow. Here are a few benefits we offer to support you:

Agentic Delivery:
Our people work in a modern way to deliver client outcomes. Broaden your skills on a range of engagements with international brands that have a global impact.

An inclusive and safe environment:
We’re truly committed to building a culture where you are celebrated and everyone feels welcome and safe.

AI & Strategic Upskilling:
Accelerate your professional growth with generous training budgets and mentorship, with a specific focus on Agentic AI expertise and the critical human skills required for the future of work.

Generous vacation policy:
Work-life balance is key to our team’s success, so we offer flexible personal time off (PTO); allowing ample time away from work to promote overall well-being.

Customizable benefits:
Tailor your extended health and dental plan to your needs, priorities, and preferences.

Flexible work arrangements:
We work in a variety of ways, from remote, to in-office, to a blend of both.

APPLY is a safe, respectful, and inclusive community where differences are celebrated. We are committed to equal opportunity and fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. Learn more in our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) section. For recruitment accommodations, please email [email protected] .

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Ne perdez pas le rythme - Postulez chez Les Industries JAM !

JAM, faire que le monde sonne mieux, une marque à la fois! Est-ce que ces mots résonnent comme de la musique à vos oreilles?

Depuis 1972, les JAM est devenu un des plus importants distributeurs de matériel électronique, d’appareillage de sonorisation professionnelle et d’instruments de musique. Venez nous joindre pour demeurer fidèle à notre mission première d’offrir UNIQUEMENT le meilleur service à la clientèle possible!

Relève de :
Vice-président principal, Transformation numérique

Résumé du poste

Relevant du vice-président principal, Transformation numérique, le ou la Directeur(trice) de projet, Transformation financière
joue un rôle stratégique à un moment charnière de la croissance de Nexora Amérique du Nord, alors que l’organisation passe de systèmes hérités fragmentés à une infrastructure de calibre entreprise. Ce poste exige une expertise approfondie en consolidation d’opérations mondiales, en mise à l’échelle de systèmes pour soutenir une forte croissance et en modernisation des opérations, processus, systèmes et capacités stratégiques de la fonction Finance.

Aperçu du rôle

Définir et diriger la stratégie globale de transformation financière afin de faire évoluer des systèmes régionaux fragmentés vers un modèle financier mondial standardisé et évolutif.

Relevant directement du vice-président principal, Transformation numérique, avec un lien fonctionnel de projet auprès du chef de la direction financière (CFO).

Assurer un leadership transversal auprès de multiples entités, fonctions et unités d’affaires afin de favoriser la réussite des initiatives de transformation.

Principales responsabilités

Élaborer et mettre en œuvre la feuille de route complète de transformation financière à l’échelle mondiale.

Assurer la gouvernance des projets, incluant les budgets, les échéanciers, les ressources, les risques et les livrables.

Diriger le déploiement de plateformes ERP, de solutions d’automatisation et de capacités avancées en analytique.

Piloter les initiatives de standardisation des processus et d’amélioration continue à travers l’organisation.

Harmoniser les processus Record-to-Report (R2R)
, Order-to-Cash (O2C)
et Procure-to-Pay (P2P)
au sein de multiples unités d’affaires.

Moderniser les capacités de données et d’analytique en mettant en place des cadres de gouvernance des données d’entreprise et en automatisant les rapports financiers ainsi que les tableaux de bord FP&A.

Développer des modèles d’intégration financière évolutifs et reproductibles afin de soutenir les futures fusions, acquisitions et intégrations d’entreprises.

Diriger les activités de gestion du changement et agir comme principal point de liaison entre les équipes Finance, Technologies de l’information et les dirigeants régionaux.

Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes TI, Opérations, Finance et les unités d’affaires afin d’assurer l’alignement et la réussite des initiatives de transformation.

Qualifications Minimales

Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe.

12 à 15 ans ou plus d’expérience progressive en leadership financier, transformation organisationnelle, gestion de programmes ou direction de projets d’envergure. Une expérience en consultation constitue un atout.

Solide expertise des plateformes ERP, notamment SAP et Oracle, ainsi que des outils de gestion des données, de production de rapports et d’analytique.

Reporting To:
SVP, Digital Transformation

Position Summary

Reporting to the SVP, Digital Transformation, the Finance Transformation Project Director operates at a critical inflection point as Nexora North America transitions from fragmented legacy systems to an enterprise-grade infrastructure. This role requires deep expertise in consolidating global operations and scaling systems to support high growth while leading large-scale modernization initiatives across finance operations, systems, processes, and strategic capabilities.

Role Overview

Define and lead the global finance transformation strategy, supporting the transition from fragmented regional systems to a standardized and scalable finance operating model.

Report directly to the SVP, Digital Transformation, with a dotted-line project reporting relationship to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO).

Provide leadership across multiple entities, functions, and business units to ensure successful transformation outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute the end-to-end global finance transformation roadmap.

Oversee project governance, including budgets, timelines, resources, risks, and key deliverables.

Lead the deployment of ERP platforms, automation solutions, and advanced analytics capabilities.

Drive process standardization and continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.

Unify Record-to-Report (R2R), Order-to-Cash (O2C), and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes across multiple business units.

Modernize data and analytics capabilities by establishing enterprise data governance frameworks and automating financial reporting and FP&A dashboards.

Develop scalable financial integration playbooks to support future mergers, acquisitions, and business integrations.

Lead change management initiatives and serve as the key liaison between Corporate Finance, Information Technology, and regional business leaders.

Partner closely with IT, Operations, Finance, and business unit leaders to ensure alignment and successful execution of transformation initiatives.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

12–15+ years of progressive experience in finance leadership, transformation, program management, or large-scale project leadership. Consulting experience is considered an asset.

Strong expertise with ERP platforms such as SAP and Oracle, as well as data management, reporting, and analytics tools.

Professional certifications such as CPA, ACCA, PMP, or Six Sigma are highly preferred.

Language Requirements

Bilingual in English & French.

Why Join Us

Ready to join our team? Here’s why …

Comprehensive group benefits: Health, Dental, Vision, Life, Critical Illness, Short- and Long-Term Disability
Wellness Incentive Program and Employee Assistance Program
RRSP / 401(k) matching program
Work-life balance matters: Flextime, summer hours, paid vacation, and personal time off
A casual, fun, and collaborative work environment
Lively social calendar—there’s always something for everyone
Generous employee discounts on our products
Ongoing learning and development opportunities
The chance to work alongside a highly talented, high-performing team

Workplace Commitments

We are committed to providing a safe and healthy work environment. All employees are expected to follow workplace safety protocols, including compliance with local regulations and internal standards, to ensure the well-being of everyone.

We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where individuals feel respected, supported, and able to contribute fully. We recognize that different perspectives and experiences strengthen our teams and drive better outcomes for our employees and customers.

jobs.title: Vice President, Finance & Tax
jobs.description:
Your Partners in Recruitment!

Thorek/Scott and Partners (TSP) has been connecting accomplished organizations with talented individuals for almost four decades. At TSP, our track record of successfully completing challenging searches across the professional spectrum has earned us an exceptional reputation at the forefront of the recruitment industry. Our Canadian and International clients include: global banks and non-bank financial institutions, private equity and investment funds, professional service firms, and entrepreneurial businesses in a variety of industries. We value the human connection and distinguish ourselves through an unwavering dedication to understanding the goals and motivations of our clients and candidates alike.

This open role is currently being featured by Thorek/Scott and Partners! We highlight a variety of open roles every week. If you save this position to apply to later, it may appear closed when you revisit it. For a full list of all open positions, please visit www.thorekscott.com.

Position Overview

Our Client is a long established Toronto-based family office. Supporting financial, investment, philanthropic and personal interests, the office exercises responsibility over a complex group of corporations, partnerships, trusts, investment entities and a private foundation, together with real estate and other family-owned assets throughout North America.

As the office continues to evolve and expand, they are seeking a VP, Finance and Treasury to take a leadership role within its finance function. Reporting to the CEO this role will provide leadership across financial reporting, tax planning and compliance, treasury, financial operations and risk management. As a trusted advisor, this individual will translate complex financial matters into clear recommendations that support wealth preservation, tax efficiency and long-term family objectives. The role will also oversee the finance team, coordinate external professional advisors and strengthen financial systems, controls and reporting.

The ideal candidate is an experienced CPA with substantial tax expertise and a background supporting high-net-worth families or complex private investment structures. They will combine strategic financial judgment with the ability to oversee detailed financial and tax matters, build trusted relationships and operate with exceptional discretion. This is an attractive opportunity to influence the financial stewardship of a diverse family office while supporting investment activities, intergenerational planning and philanthropic priorities.

Role Responsibilities

Provide financial leadership across the family office and its affiliated entities, advising on financial strategy, tax, business decisions and risk.
Oversee accounting and financial reporting for corporations, partnerships, trusts, investment entities and the private foundation, ensuring accurate and timely financial statements, management reports and coordination of external audits and reviews.
Direct budgeting, forecasting and financial analysis, developing reporting and dashboards that provide clear insight into financial performance, commitments and future funding requirements.
Lead tax planning across personal, corporate, trust, foundation and investment structures, working with external advisors to implement tax-efficient strategies and oversee Canadian and U.S. tax returns, information reporting and regulatory filings.
Support estate and succession planning, including intergenerational wealth transfer, in collaboration with family members, legal counsel and tax advisors.
Manage treasury, cash flow and liquidity across entities, overseeing banking and custodian relationships, financing arrangements and capital requirements to support investments, operations, properties and family expenditures.
Coordinate financial reporting for investment portfolios and private investments, reviewing performance, capital calls, distributions and liquidity needs with investment managers and external advisors.
Provide financial oversight of real estate holdings, private residences and other family-owned assets, and contribute financial analysis and due diligence for acquisitions, dispositions, financing transactions and major expenditures.
Oversee cross-border financial operations and related payroll, tax and compliance obligations for Canadian and U.S. activities, coordinating the work of advisors and service providers across jurisdictions.
Strengthen governance, accounting policies and internal controls; assess financial, operational, tax and regulatory risks; coordinate insurance reviews; and safeguard confidential family information.
Lead, mentor and develop the finance team, establishing clear expectations and promoting accountability, collaboration, responsiveness and service excellence.
Manage relationships with external accounting, tax, legal, banking, investment and other professional advisors, ensuring coordinated support and clear, actionable advice for family members and leadership.
Improve financial systems, reporting tools and processes through technology, automation and standardized practices that enhance efficiency, reporting quality and control.

Desired Qualifications

CPA (or equivalent) with a university degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce or a related discipline and at least 10 years of progressive finance, accounting and tax experience, including significant leadership responsibility.
Experience within a family office, private investment office, asset management firm, public accounting firm, private equity environment or complex private enterprise.
Significant experience supporting high-net-worth families and overseeing complex structures involving corporations, partnerships, trusts, foundations and investment entities.
Strong Canadian and U.S. tax expertise relevant to individuals, corporations, trusts, estates and charitable organizations, with experience coordinating cross-border financial and tax matters.
Demonstrated expertise in financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, treasury management and internal controls across multiple entities.
Understanding of investment management, private markets, real estate and wealth management structures, including their financial reporting and liquidity requirements.
Proven ability to lead and develop finance teams and coordinate external professional advisors and service providers.
Strong commercial judgment, strategic thinking and analytical skills, with the ability to assess complex issues and develop practical recommendations.
Excellent communication and relationship management skills, including the ability to explain financial and tax matters clearly and build trust with family members, senior leadership and advisors.
Exceptional discretion, integrity and professionalism, together with a responsive service orientation and the ability to manage competing priorities in a highly confidential environment.
Completion of CPA Canada’s In-Depth Tax Program, Advanced Tax Program or an equivalent tax specialization; an MBA, CFA, CBV, TEP or other relevant designation would be an asset.

Please note that at present, legal eligibility to work in Canada is a prerequisite for this role.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Enterprise Finance Systems
jobs.description:
Opentext - The Information Company

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.

At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.

Your Impact

As Senior Director, Finance Systems within OpenText’s CDO organization, you’ll have the opportunity to shape how technology enables Finance at a global scale. This is a highly visible leadership role where you’ll lead functional and technical teams responsible for Finance systems delivery, operations, and modernization, including SAP on-premises applications and integrated services.

You’ll help drive OpenText’s Finance modernization agenda, including the implementation of S/4HANA Cloud, while partnering with senior Finance and IT leaders to turn business priorities into technology outcomes. You’ll lead through complexity, leverage AI and emerging technologies, and deliver measurable value for Finance teams and business users globally.

What You Will Do

Work closely with senior leaders to understand business objectives and develop the finance systems roadmap.
Responsible for leading the team in the delivery, operational support and continuous improvement of the SAP on-premises applications.
Finance modernization including the implementation of S/4HANA Cloud capabilities and the broader ecosystem of solutions integrated into SAP
Work with Architecture and rest of the peer network to develop and maintain Financial Systems Landscape relevance.
Accountable for delivery of change & bug-fixes for all finance Systems
Accountable for the operational upkeep of the finance systems including SOX and other IT general controls.
Accountable for people agenda for the finance systems team.
Key contributor to the overall technology delivery strategy, ensuring the realization of goals such as reuse, infrastructure simplification, cost management, solution flexibility, operational resilience and the practical use of emerging technologies, including AI, to solve outcome-driven business and IT use cases.
Build strong cross-organizational relationships and effectively influence staff across the business and IT.

What You Are Great At

Building strong relationships and effectively managing expectations with senior stakeholders, business partners, peers, and external vendors.
Breaking down complex business problems into practical technology solutions, including automation and AI, to deliver measurable business and IT outcomes.
Leading effectively in a global operating model, with teams distributed across geographies and organizational structures.
Communicating complex technical and business concepts clearly and effectively to leadership and diverse audiences.
Thinking strategically and critically, developing roadmaps, and translating strategy into execution.
Managing multiple priorities, plans, and budgets in a fast-paced environment while delivering on time and on budget.
Driving best practices, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and a culture of learning across teams.
Building and motivating high-performing teams and fostering an environment of trust, collaboration, and accountability.

What It Takes To Excel

10+ years of experience leading engineering, development, or technology delivery teams.
Strong experience leading complex SAP ERP delivery and operations, including SAP on-premises platforms and integrated Finance systems.
Proven experience leading S/4HANA Cloud implementations, including program delivery, business process transformation, stakeholder alignment, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization.
Strong understanding of complementary financial systems and cross-domain technology ecosystems, including Finance, HR, and CRM.
Experience supporting technology integrations related to Mergers, Acquisitions, and Divestitures (M&A).
Experience leading multiple complex workstreams within a global organization.
High-tech software or technology services industry experience is an asset.
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant discipline, college diploma, or equivalent experience.

One Last Thing:
If you’re a strategic technology leader who thrives on transformation, enjoys solving complex business challenges, and wants to shape the future of Finance technology at a global scale, we’d love to hear from you.

OpenText's commitment to diversity and inclusion surpasses legal requirements, evident in our Equal Employment Opportunity Statement of Policy which promotes a respectful and empowering environment for employees of all backgrounds, culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.

If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a ticket at Ask HR. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

Compensation:
At OpenText, we offer a thoughtfully designed benefits package that supports your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing. As you move through the hiring process, we’re happy to provide more details about our compensation programs, including variable and commission compensation opportunities for eligible roles, vacation entitlement, and paid time off.

Salary Range:
Depending on the candidate’s education, experience, skills, geographical location, and alignment with internal equity and external market, actual salary may vary and be higher or lower than the range posted.

AI Usage Disclosure:
As part of our commitment to transparency, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in various stages of our recruitment process, including resume screening, candidate matching, interview scheduling, and communications. These tools are designed to improve efficiency, reduce bias, and enhance candidate experience. All decisions regarding hiring are made by qualified human professionals, and we continuously monitor our AI systems to ensure fairness and compliance with applicable regulations.

jobs.title: Vice President (Head) of Finance
jobs.description:
Our client is a highly respected, mission-driven organization dedicated to improving well-being and quality of life in the communities it serves. The organization is seeking a strategic and forward-thinking Vice President, Finance to join its Executive Leadership Team. Reporting to the CEO, the Vice President will provide enterprise-wide leadership across Finance and corporate services, while serving as a trusted advisor to the CEO, Board of Directors, and senior leadership team.

The organization delivers essential services to a large and diverse client base. Behind every service are countless financial, operational, and strategic decisions that turn resources into meaningful impact. As Vice President, Finance, the successful candidate will ensure the financial strength, insight, and discipline needed to advance the mission and support long-term sustainability.

This is an exceptional opportunity for an accomplished finance executive who combines strategic insight with operational leadership and wants to influence meaningful outcomes in a purpose-driven organization. More than a functional leader, the Vice President will be a key enterprise partner, helping shape strategy, support growth, and position the organization for continued success in a complex operating environment.

The Mandate

The mandate extends well beyond traditional financial stewardship. As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, the VP will help shape organizational strategy, support evidence-based decision-making, and ensure the long-term sustainability of an organization delivering critical services.

In partnership with the CEO, Board, and senior leadership team, the VP will provide strategic financial leadership across planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, treasury, audit, risk management, and compliance. They will ensure financial resources are aligned with organizational priorities while maintaining the discipline and accountability the mission requires.

A key priority will be supporting the organization through a period of growth and change. Using financial insights and performance data, the VP will help evaluate opportunities, inform strategic initiatives, and optimize the deployment of resources in a complex funding and operating environment. Success will require balancing long-term vision with disciplined execution and sound financial management.

Beyond finance, the VP will provide executive oversight of key corporate services, including procurement and facilities, ensuring effective stewardship of organizational resources and infrastructure. The role will also lead efforts to strengthen internal capabilities, foster collaboration across departments, and build a high-performing, engaged team.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to evolve the finance function from a trusted service provider into an even more proactive strategic partner and to enable data-driven decision-making across the organization. Success will be measured not only by financial outcomes, but also by the ability to influence strategy, support growth, and contribute to long-term sustainability and impact.

Leadership and Stewardship

The organization is seeking a VP Finance who leads with maturity and earns trust through action. This is not a role for someone who relies on title or tenure to get things done. The culture here rewards people who show up prepared, communicate clearly, and follow through.
Operates with humility, credibility, and sound judgment
Brings a practical, solutions-oriented mindset
Communicates clearly and influences at all levels
A good partner to the program managers – asking what they need before explaining what the number say
Leads with integrity, accountability, and transparency

Ideal Background

The successful candidate will bring experience in social services, healthcare, the boarder public sector, or the not-for-profit sector. Those who understand the operational, funding, and stakeholder dynamics of publicly funded organizations will be particular well positioned for success.
A CPA designation and progressive senior finance leadership experience.
Experience leading finance within a complex, multi-stakeholder organization.
A strong understanding of financial planning, financial reporting, treasury, governance, risk management, and internal controls.
Experience working with Boards and senior executives in a strategic advisory capacity.
The ability to translate financial information into actionable business insights.
A collaborative leadership style and a reputation for building strong relationships across an organization.

Why This Role

This is a rare opportunity to combine executive-level impact with genuine purpose. As a strategic partner to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team, the Vice President, Finance will help shape decisions that influence the organization’s direction, sustainability, and growth.

The successful candidate will join an organization at an exciting point in its journey, with the opportunity to strengthen financial stewardship, support strategic priorities, and help position the organization for continued success. The organization measures its success not only by financial performance, but by the positive impact it has on the people and communities it serves.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact and help shape the future of a mission-driven organization, we encourage you to apply in confidence.

THE PRHC DIFFERENCE:

Peterborough Regional Health Centre (PRHC) is a regional hospital delivering acute healthcare to a rapidly growing population of more than 300,000 in Peterborough and the surrounding communities, including the First Nations of Curve Lake, Hiawatha and Alderville.
With an annual budget of nearly $390 million, and a proud local history extending back over a century, PRHC has nearly 500 inpatient beds and offers a wide range of services, including specialized programs in renal, stroke, cardiac, cancer care, vascular surgery and mental health & addictions.
PRHC is located in Peterborough, Ontario, Canada a 90-minute drive north-east of Toronto. We are the region’s largest employer with more than 3,100 staff, 450 physicians with privileges, and a core group of 250 volunteers.
As a member of the PRHC team, you will be part of an exceptional working environment – a forum to share knowledge, to lead and learn, to develop talents, relationships and careers, and a culture that recognizes and celebrates the efforts and achievements of its people.
PRHC is proud to be recognized as one of the top 20 employers nationwide in the healthcare and social services category, and 199 overall among 300 Canadian employers across all sectors, on the Canada’s Best Employers list released by Forbes in 2025.

What We Offer

We're committed to supporting our people with meaningful rewards and experiences, which may include:
A competitive total rewards package aligned with the position
Pension plan with employer contributions for eligible roles
Health, wellness, and lifestyle perks, including fitness memberships and travel savings
On site gym 24/7 free to all employees
Ongoing learning and development opportunities to support your growth

HOURS OF WORK:

The stated hours of work are approximate as schedules are subject to change with the operational needs of the Health Centre. Changes made to hours of work will follow the terms of the applicable collective agreement, company policy and/or legislation.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

The Director of Finance provides strategic, operational, and administrative leadership for finance (in collaboration with the Director of Finance and Reporting). A strong leader, the Director, Finance will oversee accounts receivable, accounts payable, payroll, capital assets, treasury functions, preparation of the financial statements, enhance systems of internal control and effectively manage staff. The Director has operational accountability and will provide creative leadership and oversight to all aspects of their portfolio while continually evaluating best industry practices in comparison to internal systems and services, with an eye toward both future needs.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

Bachelor’s degree in Health Administration, Business Administration, or a related clinical discipline.
CPA designation.
Minimum 5 years of progressive leadership experience in complex health systems, with direct oversight of budgeting and financial services.
Demonstrated success in strategic planning, capital projects, and technology implementation.

WHO YOU ARE:

Strong knowledge of accounting guidelines, accreditation standards and regulatory frameworks.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and relationship management skills.
Proven ability to lead teams through change and foster continuous improvement.
Experience leading interdisciplinary project teams.
Experience in Clinical Informatics, professional practice and/or project management.
Demonstrated use of theory and research/evidence-based outcomes in practice.
Strategically focused and an innovator with a commitment to continuous quality improvement.
Demonstrated ability to lead and manage change effectively, creating a positive environment.
Demonstrated ability to achieve goals and objectives within specified time frames.
Well-developed problem solving, decision making and critical thinking skills.
Excellent organizational skills, self-directed and the ability to adapt to continually changing priorities.
Excellent analytical and budgeting skills.
Excellent time management skills.
Excellent negotiation and conflict resolution skills.

This position is for a current vacancy.

OUR COMMITMENT:

At PRHC, we take great pride in maintaining an inclusive culture of respect and a diverse workforce that reflects the community we serve. We do this because we understand that bringing different perspectives and backgrounds to the fulfillment of our mission, vision and values makes us better.
We invite all interested individuals to apply and encourage applications from members of all equity-deserving communities, including those who identify as Indigenous, black, racialized, women, people with disabilities and people with diverse gender identities, expressions, and sexual orientations. Even if your past experience doesn’t quite align with every qualification on this position, we still encourage you to apply as you may be the right candidate for another role within our organization.
Peterborough Regional Health Centre is committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment that is in compliance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (‘AODA’). Should you require accommodation through the recruitment and selection process, please notify us by indicating this on your application form and upon initial contact by our recruitment team. This will ensure that we can tailor the recruitment process to meet your accommodation needs.

jobs.title: Director, Technology Operations
jobs.description:
Job Type:
Permanent Full Time

Location:
Full Onsite - Toronto, Ontario

Reporting to:
Chief Technology Officer

Salary
: $150,000 – $170,000 CAD

Job Purpose

The Director, Technical Operations owns the operational health of the platforms Goway sells and services travel on: our reservations platform, the infrastructure it runs on, the supplier, air and distribution integrations it depends on, and the automation and data pipelines built around it.

This is a practice-building role. You will define and own Goway's technical operations discipline: service levels, incident management, change control, observability and operational readiness, and you will make them the standard across our technology organisation. You will work alongside other Technology leaders. You will own the technology operations of our platform. You will have the CTO's mandate and backing to build the practice.

What will be your key responsibilities?

Reliability and service management

Define, publish and report service levels and service-level objectives for revenue-critical services, starting with quoting, booking, payment and traveller servicing.
Own incident management end to end: severity definitions, escalation, incident command, communication during an incident, and post-incident review with corrective actions.
Own RCA and problem management.
Own change and release management as a company standard, balancing delivery throughput against change failure rate.
Build observability sufficient to detect degradation.
Own disaster recovery and business continuity for platform services, tested and documented on a stated cadence.

Integration and supplier platform operations

Monitoring of integration paths, error and failure-rate thresholds, and defined fallback behaviour when a partner degrades.
Maintain a dependency map of the external platforms our revenue-generating flows rely on, with assessed operational risk and mitigation for each.
Own operational readiness for new integrations and new product lines entering the platform.
Own the operational reliability of automation and data pipelines in production.

Platform and cloud operations

Day-to-day operation of the AWS and managed hosting infrastructure serving our platform estate: environments, provisioning, patching and lifecycle management.
Own hosting cost governance: visibility by service, a unit-cost measure, and an annual optimisation target.
Lead capacity planning against forecast booking and travel volumes.
Reduce manual, repeatable operational work through automation.
Address seasonal capacity planning, change freezes and enhanced coverage aligned to our booking and departure peaks and to new product launches.

Vendors, partners and compliance

Platform, hosting and integration partner relationships: SLA definition, enforcement and structured performance review.
Reduce single points of dependency, whether on a vendor or an individual.
Partner with security on vulnerability management, patch compliance, access control and audit readiness.

Practice leadership and stakeholder engagement

Build and maintain a multi-year technical operations roadmap aligned to Goway's growth plans.
Report operational performance, risk and investment needs to the CTO and executive team in business terms.

What are we looking for?

Required

8 or more years in platform operations, technical operations, infrastructure or site reliability engineering, including 5 or more years in a lead or leadership capacity.
Demonstrated accountability for the availability and performance of a revenue-critical transactional platform.
Evidence of having built operational practice where little existed: SLOs, incident management, change control and observability introduced from the ground up, with measurable improvement to show for it.
Hands-on depth in AWS, including cost management and multi-environment operation.
Substantial experience operating and governing third-party platforms and integrations, including holding vendors to service levels.
Ability to set standards and drive adoption across teams.
Ability to communicate operational risk and performance.

Preferred

Experience stabilising and operationalising new systems.
Infrastructure-as-code and container orchestration experience.
AWS Certified DevOps Engineer (Professional), or AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer (Associate). Solutions Architect certifications are welcome, but less relevant to this role than the operations-focused ones.
Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering or equivalent practical experience.

What can you expect from Goway?

Imagine working for a company where your career feels like an adventure. At Goway, you’ll join a global community that supports one another:
We offer a competitive salary accompanied by performance incentives, and we place real importance on time away from work, such as paid personal days for when life calls for them and your birthday off each year.
Our commitment to professional growth means you’ll have access to continuous learning and industry-leading training that keeps you at the forefront of travel innovation.
You’ll enjoy generous paid time off, including [three] weeks of vacation, [six] personal days, and a dedicated day off to celebrate your birthday.
Travel is in our DNA, so you’ll enjoy exclusive perks and discounts on worldwide getaways.
Since we operate across Toronto, Vancouver, Los Angeles, Manila, Sydney, and beyond, you’ll collaborate across cultures and shape a career path that reflects your ambitions.
Goway is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate differences and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace for everyone. We appreciate every applicant’s interest. Please be advised that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

How To Apply

If this role feels like your next step, click "Apply Now" to create your profile, upload your CV, and share a few details about yourself. Our talent team reviews every application, and if your experience aligns with our needs, we will reach out to set up the next step.

AI Screening Disclosure

To help us fairly and efficiently review applications, we use an automated screening process to assess responses to pre-determined questions. This initial step ensures all candidates are evaluated consistently. Qualified applicants will be reviewed by our recruitment team for further consideration.

Additional Notes

Goway Travel Ltd will retain applications, notifications, and records related to this posting for three years, reflecting our commitment to fair and equitable hiring practices.

Recruitment Scams & Fraud Warning

Please be aware of any suspicious emails or WhatsApp activity from individuals pretending to be recruiters or senior personnel at Goway Travel. We will never ask you to install an app during the recruitment process. If you receive a message of this nature, please ignore it and report it to Goway.

About Goway

Founded in Toronto in 1970 by Australian economist Bruce Hodge, Goway has evolved from a one-person dream into a family-owned global leader in tailor-made travel. With our headquarters in Toronto and hubs in Vancouver, Los Angeles, Sydney, and Manila, our team of over 800 talented employees designs travel experiences in more than 115 countries across all seven continents. We’re united by a passion for travel and are committed to doing the right thing: supporting diversity, equity, inclusion, and sustainable tourism that enriches local communities. Whether working remotely or side by side in one of our offices, we operate as one forward-thinking team, transforming wanderlust into life-changing adventures for our fellow Globetrotters. Discover more at goway.com.
